1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game" assumed in HTML
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
9: 
10:   // Ship definition
11:   const ship = {
12:     x: 50,
13:     y: height / 2,
14:     w: 30,
15:     h: 30,
16:     vy: 0,
17:     gravity: 0.4,
18:     thrust: -8,
19:     color: '#0f0'
20:   };
21: 
22:   // Asteroid pool
23:   const asteroids = [];
24:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
25:   let lastSpawn = 0;
26:   const asteroidSpeed = 4;
27: 
28:   let score = 0;
29: 
30:   // Input handling – click or tap anywhere
31:   const thrustShip = () => { ship.vy = ship.thrust; };
32:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', thrustShip);
33:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); thrustShip(); });
34: 
35:   // Game loop
36:   function update(dt) {
37:     // Ship physics
38:     ship.vy += ship.gravity;
39:     ship.y += ship.vy;
40:     // Prevent ship from leaving top
41:     if (ship.y < 0) { ship.y = 0; ship.vy = 0; }
42:     // Bottom lose condition
43:     if (ship.y + ship.h > height) {
44:       gameOver();
45:       return false;
46:     }
47: 
48:     // Asteroid spawning
49:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
50:       spawnAsteroid();
51:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
52:     }
53: 
54:     // Move asteroids
55:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
56:       const a = asteroids[i];
57:       a.x -= asteroidSpeed;
58:       // Collision detection (AABB)
59:       if (a.x < ship.x + ship.w && a.x + a.w > ship.x && a.y < ship.y + ship.h && a.y + a.h > ship.y) {
60:         gameOver();
61:         return false;
62:       }
63:       // Remove off-screen asteroids and increase score
64:       if (a.x + a.w < 0) {
65:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
66:         score++;
67:       }
68:     }
69:     return true;
70:   }
71: 
72:   function render() {
73:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
74:     // Draw ship
75:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
76:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
77:     // Draw asteroids
78:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
79:     asteroids.forEach(a => ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h));
80:     // Draw score
81:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
82:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
83:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
84:   }
85: 
86:   let lastTime = 0;
87:   function loop(timestamp) {
88:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
89:     lastTime = timestamp;
90:     if (update(dt)) {
91:       render();
92:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
93:     }
94:   }
95: 
96:   function spawnAsteroid() {
97:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
98:     const yPos = Math.random() * (height - size);
99:     asteroids.push({ x: width, y: yPos, w: size, h: size });
100:   }
101: 
102:   function gameOver() {
103:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
104:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
105:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
106:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
107:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2 - 60, height/2);
108:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
109:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
110:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, width/2 - 40, height/2 + 30);
111:   }
112: 
113:   // Start the game loop
114:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
115: })();
